neighbours.label: the syllable after a word-initial u-: 'ki' of ukiyo, 'ke' of uke, 'ule' of ukulele, キ of ウキウキ
fire: The museum holds rare ukiyo-e prints from Edo.
She collects ukiyo-e and old maps.
My brother left his uke on the bus.
An old uke hung on the kitchen wall.
He strums a ukulele by the fire.
Her first ukulele was a birthday gift.
明日の旅行でウキウキしています。
子どもたちはウキウキしていた。
quiet: The museum holds rare woodblock prints from Edo.
She collects woodcuts and old maps.
My brother left his bag on the bus.
An old clock hung on the kitchen wall.
He strums a banjo by the fire.
Her first banjo was a birthday gift.
明日の旅行で楽しくしています。
子どもたちは静かにしていた。

notes: Declared pieces are short and common, so measured coverage will be crude: 'ki' and 'ke' occur in many other words. The card also shows 'i', 'di' and 'o', not covered.
